exercises.title: Specification practices 1 — which practice?
exercises.problemHtml:
Five specification practices: adopt templates, identify requirement origins, uniquely label each requirement, record business rules, specify nonfunctional requirements. Which one does each action apply?

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Specification practices 1 — which practice? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Uniquely label each requirement
   - r1.k: Identify requirement origins
   - r2.k: Adopt requirement document templates
   - r3.k: Record business rules
   - r4.k: Specify nonfunctional requirements
   Templates remind you what to explore; origins tell why; labels enable tracing; rules outlive projects; nonfunctional requirements prevent "it works but nobody likes it".

exercises.title: Specification practices 2 — why each practice matters
exercises.problemHtml:
Business rules are an enterprise-level asset: they outlive any one project, so document them separately and link the requirements that enforce them. Unique labels must be robust to additions, deletions and changes — they are a prerequisite for traceability and change management.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Luật nghiệp vụ là tài sản cấp doanh nghiệp; nhãn duy nhất là tiền đề cho truy vết và quản lý thay đổi.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Specification practices 2 — why each practice matters — answer key

1. Why keep business rules separate from a project’s requirements?Vì sao tách luật nghiệp vụ khỏi yêu cầu của dự án?
   Answer: d) They outlive the project and are shared by many systems; requirements that enforce them link back to them
   Enterprise asset.VI: Tài sản doanh nghiệp.

2. Without unique, stable labels, which practices become impossible?Không có nhãn duy nhất, ổn định thì thực hành nào không làm được?
   Answer: a) Traceability and change tracking
   You cannot trace what you cannot name.VI: Không gọi tên được thì không truy vết được.

3. A product does exactly what was asked but is slow and confusing. Which practice was neglected?Sản phẩm làm đúng điều được yêu cầu nhưng chậm và khó dùng. Thực hành nào bị bỏ?
   Answer: b) Specify nonfunctional requirements
   Quality expectations were never captured.VI: Kỳ vọng chất lượng chưa từng được ghi.

exercises.title: Specification practices 4 — templates without big documents
exercises.problemHtml:
Standard templates — Vision & Scope, use case, SRS — give a consistent structure. Even on projects that do not write traditional documents, a template reminds you which kinds of requirements information to explore.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
